rules.receivingLane: receiver is continuously detected and moves at least 0.75 m in the second before release; the same defender projects onto the finite passer-to-receiver segment before and after, starts within 3 m and 25 degrees of that pass line, gains at least 0.5 m line clearance; receiver motion contributes at least 1 degree and 0.25 m with the final passer/defender fixed, while total angle grows at least 3 degrees
rules.pressureOutlet: passer has a continuously observed opponent within 4 m; receiver clearance from the same observed defender increases by at least 1 m; the next directly observed same-team connection occurs without intervening or reversed source ownership
rules.thirdPlayer: A, B and C are distinct same-team actors in uninterrupted source ownership order; C moves at least 0.6 m before B receives, at least 1 m overall, continues in the outcome direction, and gains either 1.5 m forward or 1 m clearance
rules.switchingSpace: source-labelled lateral connection spans at least 22 m and receiver clearance from the same continuously observed defender increases by at least 1 m
rules.tolerance: catalogue metrics are recomputed from centimetre-quantized exported frames; runtime comparison tolerance is 0.0011 in stored units and threshold allowance never exceeds the 0.01 m two-point quantization bound
rules.sourceActions: player_possession rows only; nullable provider flags remain nullable; receive requires is_previous_pass_matched for its incoming pass and excludes known one-touch/header/hand actions, while is_pass_reception_matched remains distinct outgoing-pass metadata; header requires is_header; one-touch pass requires one_touch plus end_type=pass with header priority; instant labels additionally require actor and ball within 3.5 m at the original contact frame
rules.carryAction: provider carry=true plus matched boundaries, uninterrupted directly observed player and ball, matching source owner, player-ball distance at most 3.5 m, and at least 2.0 m observed displacement before onset
rules.directionChangeAction: a carry-qualified observed XY trajectory only; both reached legs are at least 1.5 m and bend at least 55 degrees, without claiming body rotation
